hypothesis: Are state-dependent expert update actions usefully different from strong globally fixed or task-stage-only policies under matched learner updates and new-task progress?
objective: Use paired one-window counterfactual branches to detect a reproducible action-value heterogeneity signal before training another RL controller.
dataset: Official CIFAR-100 train only; reuse the v8 dev class pool, with no official test access or new-class generalization claim
state_sampling: Collect only the first active (monitor CE > target) decision state at the stated task stages on each reference trajectory; exclude duplicate task-1 prefixes. Report inactive and missing states, without replacing them after seeing outcomes.
batch_stream_split: Within each fixed learner state, stream 0 selects hindsight oracle actions; stream 1 evaluates that choice on an independently sampled paired training minibatch stream. All actions within a stream see identical indices and an equal 5-update window.
evaluation: Separate train-split, within-root held-out current-task and every-old-task eval batches, not monitor and not the official CIFAR-100 test split. Same eval examples across actions and streams; stream split only changes training minibatches.
primary_utility: new_eval_CE_reduction - mean_old_task_positive_eval_CE_increase, per state per 5 learner updates; report both components separately; never treat an unqualified preservation gain as success.
baseline_selection: Select the best single state-blind action and the best stage-index-only action schedule using stream-0 records from OTHER roots (leave-one-root-out). Apply them on stream 1 of the held-out root. Hindsight oracle may select each state's best stream-0 action, but it reads privileged action outcomes and is not deployable.

screening_gate.interpretation: An exploratory screening gate only, not a significance/noninferiority test or proof a state-observable policy can achieve the hindsight oracle. Any negative or underpowered gate means that the necessity of dynamic coordination is not established in this diagnostic.

cost: Record physical learner steps for reference-trajectory state collection and each action branch separately; count held-out eval calls/examples; same update count does not imply identical FLOPs or wall-clock time.
limitations: Task-ID-visible tiny two-layer fixed-raw-image-routing MoE, not a pretrained language MoE
Zero expert displacement still advances Adam moments and trains the stem and task heads
Root is the replication unit; stages, action branches and repeated streams are NOT independent experiments
Hindsight oracle is a potential-value upper-bound diagnostic, not an executable inference policy
Short-horizon first-window effects are not equivalent to end-of-sequence continual-learning improvement
Shared development class pool has been used in prior research; no held-out confirmatory result can be claimed
Do not change thresholds, action candidates, roots, or sampling after examining results
